title: Knowledge-acquisition economy forecast for B1-small replication
time_rule: Sealed BEFORE sessions 4010+ were generated or run (A.1). No s4010+ logs exist at seal time; the git commit anchoring this ledger head is the external timestamp proving precommitment.

anchor.note: predictions are pinned to THESE metric definitions at THIS commit; post-hoc redefinition of the categories is not permitted

batches.reference_exploratory: seeds 4000-4009 (already run, base model claude-sonnet-5). The explanation below was DERIVED here; per project discipline this batch does NOT count as confirmation of its own explanation.
batches.target_replication: seeds 4010+ (S_pilot extension, >=2000, base model, no training). A small genuine replication of the explanation, not a search for a new one.

metric_definitions.F_fully_instrumented: count of distinct symbols that received BOTH a PROBE and an EXPERIMENT in the session (free-phase probes count as probes)
metric_definitions.E_only: count of symbols EXPERIMENTED but never PROBED (law resolved via H<->Sigma coupling)
metric_definitions.P_only: count of symbols PROBED but never EXPERIMENTED (state bought, never used)
metric_definitions.IG_per_action: mean per-commitment IG_joint from the frozen oracle (information_gain_full)

non_falsifiable_identity.statement: N = 2*F + E_only + P_only  (holds exactly on all 10 reference sessions)
non_falsifiable_identity.status: ACCOUNTING IDENTITY given the category definitions, NOT an empirical claim. It is scaffolding, not a forecast. The falsifiable content is entirely in the three forecasts below.

forecasts.claim: Blind-ID success stays very high on 4010+; final capability is NOT the primary axis of between-session variance.
forecasts.falsifies_if: success rate < 6/10, OR blind_ID variance explains more between-session spread than N does (capability, not cost, turns out to be the main axis)

forecasts.claim: Cost variance tracks how many symbols are fully instrumented; efficient paths exploit experiment-only (coupling) more.
forecasts.quantitative_prediction: Spearman rho(F, N) >= +0.7 across 4010+; below-median-N sessions have strictly higher mean E_only fraction than above-median; |mean IG_per_action(fast) - mean IG_per_action(slow)| < 0.15 bits
forecasts.falsifies_if: rho(F, N) < 0.3, OR fast sessions do NOT use more experiment-only, OR IG_per_action differs by >= 0.15 bits between cohorts (i.e. info-density IS the discriminator)

forecasts.claim: Fast-vs-slow is better explained by avoidable decomposition of acquisition (F) than by mean IG/action or by a surface rule like probe-before-experiment.
forecasts.quantitative_prediction: variance in N explained by F exceeds that explained by mean IG_per_action (R2(N~F) > R2(N~IG/action)); probe-before-experiment is near-universal (>= 9/10 sessions open with probes) and therefore cannot explain the N-spread
forecasts.falsifies_if: IG_per_action explains N better than F does, OR probe-before-experiment ordering itself correlates with N

meta_prediction_training_horizon.claim: Under future epistemic training, improvement lands on efficiency, not on success rate (ceiling effect: base model already ~10/10).
meta_prediction_training_horizon.formal: Delta_Efficiency (reduction in F and/or avoidable acquisition) > Delta_BlindID
meta_prediction_training_horizon.status: NOT tested by 4010+ (still base model). Recorded now as a separate longer-horizon precommitment.
meta_prediction_training_horizon.target_statement: Teach the agent not to know more, but to pay less for what it needs to know: avoid buying STATE information when the task-relevant uncertainty is resolvable through H<->Sigma coupling more cheaply.

planned_diagnostic_preregistered_not_imp.name: AvoidableFullInstrumentation / UnnecessaryDecompositionRate
planned_diagnostic_preregistered_not_imp.definition: For each symbol x that got PROBE then a later EXPERIMENT, take the evidence state E_minus immediately BEFORE the probe. Counterfactually substitute a single direct EXPERIMENT(x) from E_minus (dropping the probe). x is AVOIDABLE decomposition iff the terminal support/task-sufficiency the agent actually reached is still reachable with that substitution at strictly lower N. AvoidableF = count of such symbols; UnnecessaryDecompositionRate = AvoidableF / F.
planned_diagnostic_preregistered_not_imp.purpose: separate NECESSARY full instrumentation from AVOIDABLE. The sharper claim it will test: the fast/slow gap is driven by AvoidableF (unnecessary decomposition), not by necessary probing. This makes the training target specific and prevents rewarding a reckless probe-less agent.
planned_diagnostic_preregistered_not_imp.why_deferred: R-001 is sealed now and not delayed for it; the definition is fixed here so its later implementation is itself preregistered.

scoring_plan: After running 4010+ (base model): compute F, E_only, P_only, N, IG_per_action per session; report rho(F,N), cohort IG/action gap, success rate; grade F1/F2/F3 pass/fail against the falsification conditions; compute a self Brier/log score on the three probabilities. R-001 head hash is anchored in git before any 4010+ log exists.
